conflicts.fact: Which lesson the learners' cumulative inference model was begun in, and what it looked like
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: a first-draft diagram of EVIDENCE and CONCLUSION, sealed in books as a baseline. Lesson 2: learners start a new 'Model Version 1' mind-map of General Science. Lesson 3: learners retrieve 'the personal inference model they began in Lesson 1' (HIDDEN CAUSE → INDIRECT EVIDENCE → INFERENCE → CONCLUSION) but the teacher tells them to 'Open your model from Lesson 2'.

conflicts.fact: Season/time-of-year evidence given in the farmer scenario and the pattern of wilting
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: border plants wilting, interior healthy; season mentioned only generally. Lesson 5: specifies it is the dry season when soil pests are most active, and the farmer is named Akinyi, walking the edge of her shamba early in the morning.

conflicts.fact: Number of minutes allotted to Lesson 1 model drawing
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 learner text says 'final 5 minutes' for drawing the model, but the teacher script says 'last five minutes' and then 'Give exactly 4 minutes'.

conflicts.fact: Wording of the unit Driving Question
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 closing hook: 'If the farmer never saw the pest, how could she possibly know it was there?' Lesson 3: 'How does a scientist know something is true when they cannot see it directly?' Lessons 4, 5, 8: the same plus 'and how is this power of General Science shaping life, careers, and the environment in Kenya?'

conflicts.fact: Number of lessons the cumulative model spans and the Lesson 7 model content
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says the model 'will grow across all eight lessons'; Lesson 6 says the Inference Model has been built since Lesson 1; Lesson 7 requires connections to other science topics (Cell, Nutrition) that earlier lessons never introduced.

conflicts.fact: Which future sub-strand answers the soil-pest/root question
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7: the question about how plants know they are attacked by pests underground will be answered in Sub-Strand 1.4 Transport in Plants and 1.6 Plant Growth and Development. Lesson 8: unanswered root-destruction questions anchor Sub-Strand 1.2, The Cell.

conflicts.fact: Lesson 8 mentions the farmer's name and DQB ceremony versus Lesson 7's final DQB state
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 DQB review uses green/yellow/red dots (Column A/B/C) with yellow questions to be revisited in Lesson 8; Lesson 8 uses green tick, yellow arrow, red question mark. Lesson 7 also names the farmer 'Mama Akinyi'; Lesson 5 names her 'Akinyi'; Lesson 1 gives no name.
Lesson 1 Observe Phase: 'exactly 5 learners' but also 'the 4–5 flagged during circulation plus one more' (i.e., 5–6). Lesson 5: exactly 4 learners cold-called.
